target: dense combined mean success >= .90; report 95% CI and each seed
selection_rule: Among tuning variants with mean success >= .94 and Student-t lower 95% CI >= .90, minimize energy; tie-break smaller p95. If none qualify report failure and do not inspect evaluation.
baseline: fixed, previous preregistration unchanged; also compare all eight policies
unchanged: algorithm, model, PHY, topology, traffic, lifetime, deadline, hop limit and energy assumptions
